items.english: "Why are you so quiet?" the man said, looking at the woman's face with a sudden wonder. She hurried to say something, but unable to say it in one breath she fell silent, and again her eyes ran far away. And she saw the phantom picture again. Then for the first time she quietly heard the sound of the storm outside the door. She said nothing.
notes: Kept both askings as "Why are you so quiet?" to hold the repetition of p19 and p21; Japanese varies どうして / なぜ. Kept ふと as sudden and 遠く走って as ran far away. "phantom picture" keeps 幻の絵 plain and unlocated.

items.english: Yes. That day is there. The day when all will turn into fond remembrance and forgiveness and restfulness is there. After a long life, and after a long sadness, and after a long suffering, on the day after those, that restful day of fond remembrance and forgiveness is there. What is the suffering and sadness of each day. What is the weariness and trouble of each day. Before she knew it she held a smile.
notes: Kept paired nouns as fond remembrance and forgiveness and restfulness to match p16-p17, and kept the long and... and... listing and repeated day. Left the two questions plain without answering them.

items.english: "Why are you so quiet?" the man said again. She raised her head as if startled, smiling as if with fond remembrance, "It really has been only a little while, hasn't it, since we married," she said, as if asking him too to remember, to remember all sorts of things, even the happy things from before they married.
notes: Grouped as one English paragraph; p21 ends mid-sentence and p23 is the speech tag for p22. Rendered なつかしさうに as as if with fond remembrance to keep the なつかしみ network rather than fondly.

items.english: "That's so," the man said too, raising his eyes. "It comes to only three years. But we have been through a good deal of hardship."
notes: Grouped as one paragraph in one speaker's turn. Kept 俺たち as plain we and the arithmetic literal as only three years.

items.english: "Truly," she lowered her eyes again and tried to look at that picture. But at once, "But it is still only three years, isn't it," she said, her eyes shining as if she must tell him of some great thing, something she herself did not understand, some great hope.
notes: Grouped as one paragraph; p26 breaks off mid-sentence. Kept the doubled 大きな as some great thing ... some great hope and left 希 as hope per ruby, without explaining what she does not understand.

data.say: Drafted p19 to p27 as plain supper diction with the vision's nouns repeated unchanged.
